subject: Consolidated observability renewal: credits, retention, and cutover window
messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma@sentry.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@datadog.com>, sales@grafana.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window & credit consolidation proposal for Redwood Inference

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. Per our conversation I pulled together a concise summary of the options across Sentry, Datadog and Grafana Cloud so you have a single place to compare retention add-ons, committed credits, and cutover constraints. Attached: renewal_summary_v2.pdf (3 pages).

A couple of notes up front:
- Sentry can extend existing credits for 90 days to buy time for a consolidated negotiation if you need that runway.
- Datadog is open to a cross-vendor committed slab to lower token/log ingestion unit price, but they need confirmation of expected 30-day peak ingestion patterns (sample telemetry OK).
- Grafana Cloud has a migration credit for dashboards retention when moving historical archives to object storage, requires a signed SLO amendment.

Questions for you so we can draft a single commercial:
1) Do you want a coordinated 90-day extension on current contracts while we run the bake-off?
2) Is there an internal target retention split (hot:warm:cold) you want us to model?
3) Who should be the procurement contact on your side for DocuSign and SOC 2 evidence?

Happy to hop on a 30-min call tomorrow.

Best,
Emma Clarke
Senior Partnerships, Sentry
emma@sentry.io
attachments: renewal_summary_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Emma Clarke <emma@sentry.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window & credit consolidation proposal for Redwood Inference

Emma — thanks, this is helpful. Quick answers inline: 

> 1) Do you want a coordinated 90-day extension on current contracts while we run the bake-off?
Yes. Please propose the 90-day extension for all three vendors (Datadog/Grafana/Sentry). We need uninterrupted retention while the engineering team completes the migration plan.

> 2) Is there an internal target retention split (hot:warm:cold) you want us to model?
We are planning a 14/60/365 split for indexing vs cold archival, but that can flex if cost delta is significant. Marcus (cc) will validate ingestion profiles.

> 3) Who should be the procurement contact on your side for DocuSign and SOC 2 evidence?
Procurement lead will be Monica Patel (cc) — please include her on all commercial threads and send SOC 2 / KMS integration checklist directly.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll ask Marcus to attach a 7‑day ingestion sample and a short SRE runbook for expected peak windows.
- Monica, can you own the DocuSign handoff and legal redline review?

If everyone can confirm extension language by EOD tomorrow, we can avoid lapses. I can do a 30-min when needed — prefer early morning Pacific.

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: procurement@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal window & credit consolidation proposal for Redwood Inference

Forwarding the vendor summary. Procurement — please prioritize: we want an approval path that keeps production telemetry intact and minimizes unit-cost risk during migration.

Internal notes (procurement checklist):
- Requested 90-day extension from three vendors; ask for no penalty and preserve existing credits.
- Require SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short KMS/HSM integration statement for private deployment (attach SOW-draft-obs.docx).
- Legal: prepare a one-page SLA addendum for retention tiers and index egress expectations.
- Finance: model scenario A (90-day extension + migration credits), scenario B (immediate cutover with 6-month committed slab).

Attachments to procurement: SOW-draft-obs.docx (draft)

Monica Patel
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
attachments: SOW-draft-obs.docx (docx)
From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@datadog.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Emma Clarke <emma@sentry.io>, sales@grafana.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window & credit consolidation proposal for Redwood Inference

Jonas / team — thanks for the clarity. Datadog can offer the following to keep things moving: 
- 90-day no-penalty extension preserving existing credits (doc attached: datadog-extension-offer.pdf).
- Option to pool a committed ingestion slab across Log + APM for a blended unit price if Redwood signs a single cross-vendor commercial document (we can coordinate contract terms).
- Need a 7-day sample of peak ingestion (to validate slab sizing).

Action items:
- Monica: I’ll send the DocuSign envelope by EOD Friday with the extension and a redlineable clause for pooled credits.
- Jonas/Marcus: please upload the 7-day ingestion sample to the shared doc link so we can size the slab.

Forwarded for convenience: DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelopes/EXAMPLE-12345 (placeholder)

Best,
Rajiv Patel
Strategic Accounts, Datadog
rajiv@datadog.com
attachments: datadog-extension-offer.pdf (pdf)
